Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent 3-column by 2-row desktop-pet animation sprite sheet, six frames row-major, square canvas ideally 1536x1536.
Draw Tiara Basori / 馬剃天愛星 from Makeine. Image 1 is official character identity/costume. Image 2 is ONLY the desired chibi pet rendering style, proportions and six-frame layout; replace the character completely with Tiara.
Identity: dark blue-black hair pulled neatly back into a compact low bun, short separated bangs and short side locks, gray-blue eyes; no loose long hair, no high ponytail. Light gray blazer with dark navy piping, white blouse and vertically stacked pale-blue bow ribbons, gray pleated skirt, opaque black tights, white school shoes. Chest badge has no writing.
Chibi 2.75-head-tall proportions, large expressive head, crisp clean anime outlines and pixel-edged cel shading, restrained highlights. Whole body including bun, hands and shoes fully visible.
STATE idle: standing attentively, both hands holding a small navy clipboard against torso, composed gentle smile, slight blush.
Six almost identical frames for a subtle breathing/blink loop: frames 1 and 2 eyes open, frame 3 half-lidded, frame 4 eyes closed, frame 5 half-lidded, frame 6 open again. Subtle natural motion, not six different poses. Keep figure scale, clothing, prop and feet baseline identical across every cell. Each cell contains exactly one complete independent figure with clear transparent margins, feet near 94% of its cell height, body about 84% tall. No overlaps between cells.
TRULY TRANSPARENT background. No grid lines, labels, text, watermark, ground, floor shadows, decorative sparkles or extra figures.
